The key finding in the logs is clear:

```
E0517 02:03:12.882410       7 store.go:950] annotation group ConfigurationSnippet contains risky annotation based on ingress configuration
W0517 02:03:12.882455       7 store.go:951] skipping annotation nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/configuration-snippet on ingress legacy/legacy-portal: Snippet directives are disabled by the Ingress administrator (allow-snippet-annotations=false)
```

So the `legacy-portal` Ingress was using a `nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/configuration-snippet` annotation with custom regex redirect logic. 

This confirms the upgrade enabled `allow-snippet-annotations=false` by default as a security hardening measure, blocking the configuration-snippet annotation that handled those regex-based redirects. The ticket notes the standard redirect annotations can't express the regex capture groups needed, so I need to find a way to restore that functionality safely.
